name: Davco Sanitized Colorgrout
paste:
DAVCO® SANITIZED COLORGROUT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco® Sanitized Colorgrout, April 2025, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/davco-sanitized-colorgrout.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco® Sanitized Colorgrout where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2025, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - A premium cementitious grout designed for use with most types of ceramic tiles and natural stone applications.
    - Davco® Sanitized Colorgrout is design for use in joints from 1-6 mm width.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Commercial and domestic walls and floors including swimming pools and wet areas.
    - It is not suitable for use in harsh and demanding environments or where there are hygienic requirements i.e. commercial kitchens, public toilets, food processing plants etc. For these types of installations, use a suitable Sika epoxy tile grout.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco® Sanitized Colorgrout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2025, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007.3: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product Declaration (p.1).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Mould and bacteria resistant - Sanitized®
    - Ideal for dry and wet areas including swimming pools and spas
    - For joints 1-6mm wide
    - Available in various colours to suit your application
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product Declaration: CG2 WA Classification - AS ISO 13007.3
    - Bulk Density: 1.4kg/L
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 3g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in a 1.5kg, 5kg or 15kg bag
    - Shelf life: 15kg paper bags - 12 months from date of manufacture if unopened. 1.5kg & 5kg plastic film bags - 18 months from date of manufacture if unopened
    - Storage conditions: Store off ground in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2025, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Before commencing grouting, ensure the tile adhesive has set firmly. This usually requires 24 hours with the majority of tile adhesives
    - Remove any spacer lugs, rake-out any excess adhesive and any loose or foreign material from the grout joints
    - In general, ensure the grout joints are clean and dry

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2025, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Pot Life: 40 Minutes, Measured at 23°C and 50% relative humidity
4.3 Mixing Ratio.
    | Application | Mix requirements per |
    | 15kg bag |
    | General applications | 3-3.4 Ltrs of clean cool |
    | potable water |
    | Areas subject to consid- | 1.9L of Davco 4 in 1 |
    | erable movement or | Grout Additive + 1.9L of |
    | improved adhesion re- | clean, potable water |
    | quirements |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Consumption. The coverage of the grout will vary depending upon the texture, size and thickness of the tile and the width of the grout joint. Use the table below as a general guide: QTY OF GROUT REQUIRED KG/M2 JOINT WIDTH
    | Tile Size | 1.5mm joint | 3mm joint | 6mm joint |
    | 50x50x6mm | 0.8kg | 1.6kg |
    | 100x100x6mm | 0.4kg | 0.8kg | 1.6kg |
    | 150x150x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg | 1.2kg |
    | 200x100x6mm | 0.3kg | 0.6kg | 1.2kg |
    | 300x300x10 | 0.3kg | 0.5kg | 1.0kg |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Applied Product Ready for Use.
    | Application | Wait time |
    | Dry areas & light foot traffic | 24 hours |
    | Wet areas | 5 days |
    | Submerged - prior to filling with wa- | 21 days |
    | ter |
    | All measurements are taken at 23ºC and 50% relative humidity. Specifications vary according to site conditions and should be taken as a guide only |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.6 Equipment.
    - Grout float or grout applicator
    - Slow speed mixing drill with stirrer attachment
    - Mixing buckets
    - Grouting sponge
    - Microfibre cloth
4.7 Mixing. 1. Measure the right amount of clean, potable water into a clean bucket. 2. Slowly add the powder into the water while mixing with a mixing paddle attached to a drill. Do not mix by hand. 3. Continue to mix for several minutes until a creamy consistency is achieved, free of lumps of powder. 4. Allow mixture to stand for 5 minutes, remix then use the grout.
    - The grout may stiffen during the pot life, restir without adding additional water.
4.8 Application. 1. Prior to grouting it is advisable to lightly dampen the grout joints, particularly with porous tiles or in warmer conditions. If the tiles are particularly porous it is advisable to prime the joints with Davco 4 in 1 Grout Additive after dampening to seal the edge of the tile. 2. Using a rubber float or squeegee work the grout into the joints in a diagonal motion making sure that the grout does not just sit on top of the joint i.e. the grout does not bridge the joint. 3. Remove excess grout from the surface of the tiles with the rubber float or squeegee using a diagonal motion. 4. Use a damp sponge to clean up the remainder of the grout. Regularly rinsing the sponge out to assist in cleaning. 5. Finally remove any excess moisture from the grout joints, to avoid discolouration or colour variation problems. 6. Allow the grout to cure for 24 hours before cleaning the grout haze with a soft dry cloth. 7. Hard to remove haze can be cleaned with Davco Sanitized® Tile & Grout Cleaner.
    - Allow product to set firmly before return to service
    - Setting times of grout is affected by site conditions, climate and could be faster or slower than specified
4.9 Cleaning of tools. Clean tools and equipment with water before the grout dries.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2025, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco® Sanitized Colorgrout, April 2025, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/davco-sanitized-colorgrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Davco Sanitized Colorgrout, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/l/MSDS%20Davco%20Sanitized%20colourgrout%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Sanitized Colorgrout, version 07/07/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sds-davco-sanitizedcolorgrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Sanitized Colorgrout, version 01/10/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/0/sds-davco-sanitizedcolorgrout.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
